Supersedes #30130 (same change; that branch's commit message failed `check-commit-card-trailers`).

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

The maintainer waived the model-tier mandate while that tier had no quota; this PR was developed below it.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`rest-channel.md` 写侧公告两行重写:L50 保留 main 的措辞并加 `advisory_read`,L51 记 `advisory_report` 403 复测不复现与席位规则。
- 为什么改:卡上复测(评论 6632996128)经中继新报一次无 403,11-02 那批 403 不复现;单次隔日成功也合账号日限,故只记不复现。
- 风险与回滚:Tier S `.claude/**` 文字,行数不变(82,上限 82),不进任何包,`skip-changeset`;回滚即 revert。
- 先看:L50-51 两行。
- 需要你做的:无;席位 contract review PASS 且检查全绿即落地。

## What changes

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/rest-channel.md`, write side, two lines rewritten, none added:

- **L50** keeps main's wording from #30135 (`等操作`, `发布亦经中继`), now also names `advisory_read`, and keeps the pointer to `security-findings.md`. The old L51's detail (one-time key in the seat process, ciphertext back, `--reveal` prints plaintext) already lives in `security-findings.md` L21 and `lanes/security.md` L19, so folding it in loses no rule.
- **L51** records the reading and the seat-side rule in one line: a later `advisory_report` 403 did not reproduce on re-test (`复测不复现`; a single success on a later day is also what the daily limit predicts, so the line claims no more); the seat reads a 403 against the two causes `security-findings.md` L22 already names (the advisory write grant and the per-account daily limit on private reports), retries once on a later day, and never switches account.

`security-findings.md` is not edited: the reading does not make L22 wrong, it only says the 11-02 run did not hit either cause as a standing state.

**Ratchets.** Line count 82 → 82 (ceiling 82, the added rule line is paid by folding L51 into L50). Widths: L50 119 bytes, L51 115 bytes, under the 120-byte cap.

## Why

The card's last bullet. The 11-02 runs answered HTTP 403 on every `advisory_report` after the first. On 2026-11-04 a fresh report through the relay succeeded with no 403, and the maintainer confirmed the lane App shows as reporter on it and on the reports of the last two days (card comment 6632996128). The seat needs a written rule for the next 403 so it neither resends into a refusal nor reaches for another account.

## Verification

Head `6492c26c`: two commits plus a hand merge of `origin/main` (no rebase, no amend). The merge resolves the L50-51 conflict with #30135, which had rewritten L50; L51 is unchanged.

<details><summary>Local gates on 6492c26c: 17 derived, 17 run with exit 0, 0 NOT MEASURED (`dispatch-gates --ran`)</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 17 commands for the one changed file. All ran after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, each with its exit code captured before any pipe. `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint` were built first, which `check:doc-formula-expressions` needs.
- All 17 exited 0, among them `check:pm-skill-ratchet`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:skill-frame-sync`, `check:doc-authoring` and `check-comment-mask-corpus.mjs`.
- `--ran` printed: `17 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 17 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 17 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)`.
- `node scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs --base origin/main`: exit 0. No changeset: `.claude/**` ships in no package, so `skip-changeset`.
- `node scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --range origin/main..HEAD`: exit 0, run before the push.

</details>
